data.titulo: Kɛ Je Israel Kekleekle Matsɛ Nɔ Kɛ Ya Su Benɛ A Ngɔ Ma a Nyɔguɛ Kɛ Ho Babilon Ya
data.contenido:
Saul ba pee Israel matsɛ kekle. Se Yehowa kua lɛ, nɛ e hla David kɛ ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e nane mi. Wa maa kase David he sanehi fuu. Benɛ David ji niheyo ɔ, e kɛ nyumu oblai ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Goliat hwu ta. Pee se ɔ, David tu fo kɛ je Matsɛ Saul hunga jelɔ ɔ nya. Jehanɛ, yo ní lelɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abigail tsi David nya kɛ je ní peepee ko nɛ níle be mi ɔ he.

Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, wa maa kase níhi fuu kɛ je David binyumu Salomo nɛ́ ji nɔ nɛ ba ye David se kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ he. Israel matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, tsuo ye tsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛɛywiɛ. Salomo gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel nɔyemi ɔ mi ba gba enyɔ kɛ pee yiti je matsɛ yemi, kɛ woyi je matsɛ yemi.

Yiti je wɛtso nyɔngma matsɛ yemi ɔ hi si jeha 275 loko Asiriabi ba kpata e hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ jeha 133 se ɔ, a kpata woyi je wɛtso enyɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ hu hɛ mi. Nɛ a muɔɔ Israelbi ɔmɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ho Babilon ya. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Mi Gbami EYWIƐ ɔ ngɔ jeha 510 ngɛ yinɔ sane mi. Wa maa na sanehi babauu nɛ ya nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ngɛ jeha nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo mi.

HYƐ Samuel nɛ ngɛ nu plɛe kɛ ngɛ nyumu ɔ yi kpɛti puee. Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ha nɔ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a to lɛ matsɛ. Yehowa de Samuel kaa e plɛ nu ɔ kɛ pue Saul yi kpɛti. Nu nɛ ɔ ji nu slɔɔto ko nɛ jee via saminya.

Saul susuu we kaa e sa nɔ nɛ yeɔ matsɛ. E de Samuel ke: ‘Benyamin wɛtso nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ Israel ɔ mi no ji mi. Mɛni heje nɛ o ke ma ye matsɛ ɔ?’ Yehowa suɔ Saul ejakaa e pee we e he kaa nɔmlɔ ngua ko nɛ́ he ngɛ se nami. Enɛ ɔ heje nɛ Mawu to lɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ.

Se Saul pi nɔmlɔ nyafii loo ohiatsɛ. E je sikatsɛmɛ a weku mi, nɛ e ka gagaa gbãuu kɛ e he fɛu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be Israel nɛ e kami kɛ lɛ sɔ! Jehanɛ se, Saul ji nyumu nɛ he wa saminya, nɛ e he sɔɔ kɛ fo tumi wawɛɛ hulɔ. Mabi ɔmɛ a bua jɔ he kaa Yehowa hla Saul konɛ e ye a nɔ matsɛ. Mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa kɛ de ke: ‘Matsɛ ɔ yi nɛ ná wami!’

Israel henyɛli ɔmɛ a he wa saminya. A ngɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ haoe kpamisa. Benɛ a to Saul matsɛ ɔ, e kɛ we tsɔ nɛ Amonbi ɔmɛ je ta kɛ ba ná mɛ. Se Saul bua ta hwuli babauu nya, nɛ e kɛ ye Amonbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. Enɛ ɔ ha mabi ɔmɛ a bua jɔ nitsɛ kaa Saul ji a matsɛ.

Saul nyɛɛ Israel hɛ mi ngɛ jeha amɛ a mi kɛ ye a henyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi babauu. Saul ngɛ binyumu kãtsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yonatan. Yonatan hu ye bua Israel kɛ ye kunimi ngɛ tahi fuu mi. Se loloolo ɔ, Filistibi ɔmɛ ji Israel henyɛli pe kulaa. Ligbi ko ɔ, Filistibi akpeakpehi abɔ ba ná Israel konɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ hwu ta.

Samuel de Saul kaa e mlɛ lɛ nɛ́ e ba sa bɔ, aloo e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ha Yehowa loko a ya ta a. Se Samuel ya sui lejɛ ɔ mla. Nɛ akɛnɛ Saul ye gbeye kaa Filistibi ɔmɛ maa je ta a sisi heje ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ho ya sa bɔ ɔ. Benɛ Samuel ba su ɔ, e de Saul kaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ ji tue gbomi. Samuel de lɛ ke: ‘Yehowa maa hla nɔ kpa konɛ e ye Israel nɔ matsɛ.’

Pee se ɔ, Saul gbo tue ekohu. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Samuel de lɛ ke: ‘E hi kaa o maa bu Yehowa tue pe nɛ́ o maa ngɔ to nɛ tu zɔ pe kulaa kɛ ha lɛ kaa nike ní. Akɛnɛ o gbo Yehowa tue heje ɔ, e ma kpa mo Israel nɔ matsɛ yemi.’

Ní kasemi agbo ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ha wɔ. E tsɔɔ wɔ bɔnɛ e he hia ha kaa waa bu Yehowa tue be tsuaa be. Jehanɛ hu e tsɔɔ wɔ kaa, nɔmlɔ kpakpa kaa bɔnɛ Saul ji kekle ɔ, ma nyɛ ma tsake kɛ pee nɔmlɔ yayami. Wa sume kaa waa pee nimli yayamihi, aloo pi ja?1 Samuel yi 9 kɛ ya si 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samuel 1:23. Sane Bimihi

ANƐ o na nɔ́ nɛ ba a lo? Nyumuyo ɔ kpɔ to bi nɛ ɔ kɛ je osisiblisi ɔ dɛ mi. Osisiblisi ɔ ba nu to bi ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ́ e ya kpe lɛ. Se nyumuyo ɔ tu fo kɛ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ e ya kpɔ to bi ɔ ngɛ osisiblisi ɔ nya mi. Nɛ benɛ osisiblisi ɔ plɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ, nyumuyo ɔ fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbo! Be kpa ko hu ɔ, e kpɔ jijɔ ɔmɛ kake kɛ je jata dɛ. Anɛ pi nyumuyo kãtsɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo? O le nɔ nɛ e ji lo?

Lɛ ji nyumuyo David. E ngɛ Betlehem. E nɛnɛ ji Obed, nɛ ji Rut kɛ Boaz bi ɔ. Anɛ o kai mɛ lo? Nɛ David tsɛ ji Ishai. David hyɛɔ e tsɛ tohi. A fɔ David benɛ Yehowa to Saul matsɛ jeha 10 se.

Be ba su nɛ Yehowa de Samuel ke: ‘Ngɔɔ nu nɛ o ya Ishai we ɔ mi ngɛ Betlehem. I hla e binyumu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kaa e ye matsɛ.’ Benɛ Samuel na Eliab nɛ ji Ishai binyumu nɔkɔtɔma a, e de ngɛ e yi mi ke: ‘Niinɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ Yehowa hla a nɛ.’ Se Yehowa de lɛ ke: ‘Koo hyɛ e kami kɛ e he fɛu ɔ. Pi lɛ nɛ i hla kaa e ye matsɛ.’

Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Ishai tsɛ e binyumu Abinadab kɛ ba Samuel ngɔ. Se Samuel de lɛ ke: ‘Dɛbi, lɛ hu Yehowa hlɛ lɛ.’ Lɔɔ se ɔ, Ishai tsɛ e binyumu nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ji Shama hu kɛ ba. Se Samuel de ke: ‘Dɛbi, lɛ hu Yehowa hlɛ lɛ.’ Ishai ngɔ e binyumuhi kpaago kɛ ba Samuel hɛ mi, se Yehowa kplɛɛ we a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ. Samuel bi Ishai ke: ‘O binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ lo?’

Ishai ha heto ke: ‘E piɛ a senɔ wayoo kulaa a, se e ya ngɛ tohi hyɛe ngɛ nga a nɔ.’ Benɛ a ya tsɛ David kɛ ba a, Samuel na kaa e he ngɛ fɛu saminya. Yehowa de Samuel ke: ‘Lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, pɔɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’ Samuel pee bɔnɛ a de lɛ ɔ. Be maa su nɛ David maa ye Israel nɔ matsɛ.1 Samuel 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Sane Bimihi

FILISTIBI ɔmɛ ba ekohu kaa a kɛ Israel ma ta hwumi. David nyɛminyumuhi nikɔtɔma etɛ ɔmɛ piɛɛ Saul ta hwuli ɔmɛ a he. Lɔɔ he ɔ, ligbi ko Ishai de David ke: ‘Ngɔɔ ngma kɛ abolo bɔɔ kɛ ya ha o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o kɛ hyɛ bɔnɛ a ngɛ ha.’

Benɛ David ya su a sito he ɔ, e tu fo kɛ ho ta a nya ya nɛ e ya hla e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ. Filistino oblai nɛ ji Goliat ɔ je kpo nɛ e ba ye Israelbi ɔmɛ a he fɛu. E kpa ngmlaa ke: ‘Nyɛ je nyɛ ti nɔ kake nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ ba nɔ kunɔ. Ke e gbe mi ɔ, wa ma plɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛhi. Se ke i gbe lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ma plɛ wa nyɔguɛhi. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je nɔ ha mi konɛ e kɛ mi ba kpe nɛ waa hyɛ.’ E pee enɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia, ligbi 40 sɔuu. David bi ta hwuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ke: ‘Ke nɔ ko gbe Filistino nɛ ɔ, nɛ e je Israel kɛ je ahlua bɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni a ma ha lɛ?’

Ta hwuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake de David ke: ‘Saul maa ke jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ní babauu. Nɛ e ma ha lɛ e biyo hu nɛ e ngɔ.’

Se Israelbi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Goliat gbeye yee ejakaa e je oblai nitsɛ. E ka pe nine mi blimi nyɔngma kɛ etɛ, nɛ e ngɛ ta hwulɔ kpa nɛ hɛɛɔ e tsɛ̃i ɔ kɛ haa lɛ.

Israel ta hwuli ɔmɛ eko ya de Matsɛ Saul kaa David suɔ kaa e kɛ Goliat maa nɔ kunɔ. Se Saul de David ke: ‘O be Filistino nɛ ɔ nyɛe. Ejakaa niheyo wayoo kɛkɛ ji mo, se lɛɛ e bɔni ta hwumi kɛ.’ David he nɔ ke: ‘I gbe osisiblisi kɛ jata ko nɛ ba nu ye tsaatsɛ to ɔmɛ eko ɔ. Nɛ ma pee Filistino nɛ ɔ kaa bɔnɛ i pee lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Yehowa maa ye bua mi.’ Lɔɔ he ɔ, Saul de David ke: ‘Yaa, Yehowa nɛ piɛɛ o he.’

David ya pa tue nɛ e ya kukuɔ dongo tɛ enuɔ, nɛ e ngɔ wo e kotoku ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e amlami ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho konɛ e kɛ Goliat oblai ɔ nɛ ya kpe. Benɛ Goliat na lɛ ɔ, e pee lɛ nyakpɛ. E susu kaa David gbemi be yee ha lɛ kulaa.

Goliat de lɛ ke: ‘Moo lɛɛ moo ba, nɛ ma ngɔ o helo kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ nga mi lohwehi nɛ a ye.’ Se David de lɛ ke: ‘Moo lɛɛ o ma ye ngɔ kɛ klaate, kɛ akplɔ kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, se imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ ngɛ Yehowa biɛ mi. Mwɔnɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yehowa maa ngɔ mo kɛ wo ye dɛ mi, nɛ ma gbe mo.’

Kɛkɛ nɛ David sa fo konɛ e kɛ Goliat nɛ ya kpe. E je tɛ kake kɛ je e kotoku ɔ mi kɛ wo amlami ɔ mi, nɛ e fɔ kɛ e he wami tsuo. Tɛ ɔ ya fia Goliat hɛ nya kɛ sɛ e yi mi, kɛkɛ nɛ e nɔ si nɛ e gbo! Nɛ benɛ Filistibi ɔmɛ na kaa a tatsɛ ɔ gbo ɔ, mɛ tsuo a tu fo. Israelbi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ a ya ye a nɔ kunimi.1 Samuel 17:1-54. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: Nɔ́ Heje Nɛ E Sa Kaa David Nɛ Tu Fo
data.contenido:
BENƐ David gbe Goliat se ɔ, Israel tatsɛ Abner ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Saul ngɔ. Saul bua jɔ David he saminya. Nɛ e ngɔ David kɛ to e tabuli ɔmɛ a nya asafoatsɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ e hi matsɛ we ɔ mi.

Pee se benɛ tabuli ɔmɛ je a kɛ Filistibi ɔmɛ a ta hwumi ɔ kɛ ba a, Israel yi ɔmɛ la ke: ‘Saul gbe akpehi, se David lɛɛ e gbe akpe nyɔngmahi.’ Enɛ ɔ ha Saul je David he hunga, ejakaa a ngɔ anunyami fuu kɛ ha David pe lɛ. Se Saul binyumu Yonatan lɛɛ e ji David he hunga. E suɔ David saminya, nɛ David hu suɔ lɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a wo a sibi si kaa a maa pee huɛmɛ daa. David le sanku fiami saminya, nɛ Saul suɔ e la amɛ. Se ligbi ko ɔ, Saul hunga jemi ɔ ha nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi sãasaa. Benɛ David ngɛ sanku ɔ fiae ɔ, Saul ngɔ e we akplɔ ɔ, nɛ e fɔ konɛ e kɛ gbe David. Nɛ e de ke: ‘Ma hɛ David akplɔ kɛ pi gbogbo ɔ!’ Se David yu e he, nɛ akplɔ ɔ ya hɛ gbogbo ɔ. Lɔɔ se ɔ, Saul ka David akplɔ hɛmi ekohu se akplɔ ɔ na we lɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, David na kaa e sa nɛ e hyɛ e he nɔ saminya.

Anɛ o kai Saul si womi ɔ lo? E de kaa e maa ngɔ e biyo ɔ kɛ ha nyumu nɛ maa gbe Goliat. Nyagbe ɔ, Saul de David ke e maa ngɔ e biyo Mikal kɛ ha lɛ, se loko e ma ha lɛ e biyo ɔ, ja e gbe a henyɛli nɛ ji Filistibi 100. Mo susu enɛ ɔ he nɛ o hyɛ! Saul susumi ji kaa Filistibi ɔmɛ maa gbe David. Se a nyɛ we nɛ a gbe lɛ, lɔɔ heje ɔ, Saul ngɔ e biyo ɔ kɛ ha David.

Ligbi ko ɔ, Saul de Yonatan kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo kaa e maa gbe David. Se Yonatan de e tsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Koo ye David awi. Ejakaa e pee we mo nɔ́ yayami ko. Mohu ɔ, o ná nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ he se babauu. E ngɔ e wami kɛ wo oslaa mi kɛ gbe Goliat, nɛ o bua jɔ.’

Saul bu e bi ɔ tue nɛ e wo si kaa e be David awi yee. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, Saul ha David kpale kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ba bɔni lɛ sɔmɔmi ekohu. Se ligbi ko benɛ David ngɛ sanku fiae ɔ, Saul fɔ e we akplɔ ɔ ekohu kaa e ma kɛ hɛ David. David yu e he, nɛ akplɔ ɔ ya hɛ gbogbo ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛne nɛ Saul ka David gbemi! Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ, David yɔse kaa e sa nɛ e tu fo!

Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, David ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya. Se Saul tsɔ ni komɛ kaa a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mikal le nɔ́ nɛ e tsɛ ɔ to kaa e maa pee ɔ. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, e de e huno ɔ ke: ‘Ke o ji hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o ma gbo loko je maa na.’ Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mikal ye bua David nɛ e gu saflɛ mi kɛ tu fo. David hi laami tso mi maa pee jeha kpaago bɔnɛ pee nɛ Saul nine nɛ ko su e nɔ.1 Samuel 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Sane Bimihi

ANƐ o le yo kɛ e he fɛu nɛ́ e kɛ David ma kpemi ɔ lo? A tsɛɛ lɛ Abigail. E ngɛ níle, lɔɔ heje ɔ, e tsi David nya ngɛ nɔ́ yayami ko peemi he. Se loko wa maa kase lɔɔ ɔ, ha nɛ waa hyɛ níhi nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ David si himi mi.

Benɛ David tu fo kɛ je Saul nya a, e ya laa ngɛ tɛ puɔ ko mi. E nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ kɛ e wekuli tsuo ya piɛɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyumuhi maa pee kaa 400 ya piɛɛ e he, nɛ David pee a nyatsɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, David ya Moab matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ e ya de lɛ ke: ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha ye tsɛ kɛ ye nyɛ nɛ a hi o ngɔ kɛ ya si benɛ ma na ye níhi a nya.’ Pee se ɔ, David kɛ nyumuhi nɛ piɛɛ e he ɔ ya laa ngɛ yokuhi a mi.

Enɛ ɔ se nɛ David kɛ Abigail ya kpe ɔ nɛ. E huno Nabal ɔ ji niatsɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba. E ngɛ jijɔ 3,000 kɛ apletsi hu 1,000. Nabal ji kpɛletsɛ. E yo Abigail lɛɛ e he ngɛ fɛu saminya nɛ e le bɔnɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa hulɔ. Be ko po ɔ, e baa e weku ɔ yi. Ha nɛ waa hyɛ bɔnɛ e ba ha.

David kɛ e webi ɔmɛ pee Nabal kpakpa. A bu e to ɔmɛ a he ha lɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, ligbi ko ɔ, David tsɔ e webi ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ ya Nabal ngɔ kaa e dloo mɛ niye ní bɔɔ. David tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Nabal ngɔ benɛ e kɛ e we apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sãe. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji okplɔɔ ngmɛmi ligbi, heje ɔ, Nabal ngɛ niye ní kpakpahi fuu nɛ a maa ye. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, David tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: ‘Wa pee mo kpakpa. Wa jui o to ɔmɛ eko, mohu ɔ, wa bu a he ha mo. Lɔɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha wɔ niye ní bɔɔ ko nɛ wa ya ye.’

Nabal de mɛ ke: ‘I kɛ ye niye ní be nimli kaa nyɛ hae.’ E jɛ David, nɛ e tu munyu yayahi fuu kɛ si lɛ. David tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se nɛ a ya bɔ David amaniɛ. David mi mi fu wawɛɛ. E de mɛ ke: ‘Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ klaate ɔmɛ!’ Kɛkɛ nɛ a pue Nabal we ɔ mi blɔ konɛ a ya gbe e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ.

Nabal apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nu munyu nɛ Nabal tu ɔ, nɛ e ho ya de Abigail. Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ Abigail to niye ní he blɔ nya. E ngɔ niye ní ɔ kɛ pue tejihi a nɔ nɛ e pue blɔ. Benɛ e kɛ David ya kpe ɔ, e kple si ngɛ e teji ɔ nɔ nɛ e kpla si ngɛ David hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke: ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, koo po ye huno ɔ nya mi. E biɛɛ, nɛ e peeɔ níhi nɛ níle be mi. O nɛ́ nike ní ko. I kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ nike ní nɛ ɔ, konɛ o ngɔ wa tɔmi ɔ kɛ pa wɔ.’

David de lɛ ke: ‘Yo ní lelɔ ji mo. O tsi ye nya kɛ je Nabal gbemi he, ngɛ kpɛle su nɛ e je kpo ɔ heje. Yaa o we mi ngɛ he jɔmi mi.’ Pee se benɛ Nabal gbo ɔ, Abigail ba pee David yi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.1 Samuel 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Sane Bimihi

SAUL ka kaa e nine maa su David nɔ ekohu. E ngɔ e tabuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti katsɛmɛ 3,000 nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho konɛ a ya hla David. Benɛ David ná le enɛ ɔ, e tsɔ slaali konɛ a ya hla he nɛ Saul kɛ e tabuli ɔmɛ ya to. Lɔɔ se ɔ, David bi e tabuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni enyɔ ke: ‘Nyɛ kpɛti mɛnɔ kɛ mi maa ya Saul sito he ɔ?’

Abishai ha heto ke: ‘Ma ya.’ Abishai ji David nyɛmiyo Zeruya binyumu. Benɛ Saul kɛ e tabuli ɔmɛ hwɔ mahe ɔ, David kɛ Abishai pee blɛuu kɛ ya a sito he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ Saul akplɔ kɛ e nyu tɔ nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ e yi tetle mi ɔ kɛ je. Nɔ ko nɛ mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko hu nui a he ejakaa a hwɔ mahe vii.

Hyɛ David kɛ Abishai amlɔ nɛ ɔ. A je kɛ ya da si ngɛ yoku ko nɔ ngɛ he ko banee. David kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Israel tabuli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Abner, mɛni heje nɛ o bui o nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ ji matsɛ ɔ he? Hyɛ! Jije e akplɔ kɛ nyu tɔ ɔ ngɛ?’

Saul hɛ tsiɛ. E le David gbi mi tso, nɛ e bi lɛ ke: ‘David, mo ji nɛ ɔ?’ Anɛ o na Saul kɛ Abner nɛ a daa si ngɛ foni ɔ mi ngɛ sisi blɔ lo?

David he nɔ ke: ‘Ee, ye nyɔmtsɛ.’ Nɛ David bi lɛ ke: ‘Mɛni heje o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi? Mɛni yayami i pee mo? Matsɛ, hyɛ o we akplɔ ɔ. Ha nɛ o tabuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ e ba ngɔ.’ Saul he nɔ ke: ‘I tɔ̃, nɛ i je kuasia.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ David si lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Saul hu pue blɔ kɛ ho we mi ya. Se David de e he ke: ‘Ligbi kake nɛ Saul maa gbe mi. Ma tu fo kɛ ho Filistibi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya.’ Nɛ e pee ja. David nyɛ nɛ e sisi Filistibi ɔmɛ nɛ a he ye kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ a blɔ fa mi.

Pee se ɔ, Filistibi ɔmɛ kɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta. Nɛ a gbe Saul kɛ Yonatan tsuo ngɛ ta a mi. Enɛ ɔ wo David aywilɛho wawɛɛ, nɛ e po la ko ke: ‘Ye nyɛmi Yonatan, i ngɛ o he aywilɛho yee. I suɔ mo saminya!’

Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David kpale kɛ ho Hebron ya, ngɛ Israel. Kɛkɛ nɛ ta ba te si ngɛ Saul webi nɛ suɔ kaa Saul binyumu Ishboshet nɛ ye matsɛ kɛ nihi hu nɛ suɔ kaa David nɛ ye matsɛ ɔ a kpɛti. Se nyagbe ɔ, David webi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ kunimi. David ye jeha 30 nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ. E ye tsɛ ngɛ Hebron jeha kpaago kɛ fa. Nɛ bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ekomɛ a biɛ ji Amnon, Absalom kɛ Adoniya.

Be ba su nɛ David kɛ e webi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ ma ngua nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yerusalem ɔ. Yoab nɛ ji David nyɛmiyo Zeruya binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, David pee Yoab e tabuli ɔmɛ a tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma. Jehanɛ ɔ, David bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yerusalem.1 Samuel 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuel 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Kronika 11:1-9. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: Haomi Ngɛ David We ɔ Mi
data.contenido:
BENƐ David bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, Yehowa ha e tabuli ɔmɛ ye a henyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi ngɛ tahi fuu mi. Yehowa wo si kaa e maa ngɔ Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha Israelbi ɔmɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ Yehowa yemi kɛ buami nya a, zugba a tsuo ba pee a nɔ.

David ji nɔ yelɔ kpakpa. E suɔ Yehowa. Lɔɔ he ɔ, benɛ e ngɔ Yerusalem se ɔ, níhi nɛ e pee kekleekle ɔ a kpɛti kake ji kaa, e ngɔ Yehowa somi daka a kɛ ba Yerusalem. Nɛ e suɔ kaa e ma sɔlemi we konɛ e ngɔ somi daka kɛ to lejɛ ɔ.

Benɛ David ba wa a, e pee yayami agbo ko. David le kaa e ji tɔmi kaa e maa ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ ji nɔ kpa nɔ́. Se gbɔkuɛ nya si ko, benɛ David ngɛ si slaae ngɛ e tsu ɔ yi mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, e hyɛ zugba nɛ e na yo ko nɛ́ he ngɛ fɛu saminya. A tsɛɛ lɛ ke Batsheba, nɛ e huno ɔ ji David tabuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Uria.

David bua jɔ Batsheba he saminya, heje ɔ, e tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ mi. E huno ɔ ho ta ya. David kɛ Batsheba hwɔ si, nɛ pee se ɔ, Batsheba na kaa e ngɔ hɔ. David hao wawɛɛ nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya de e tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma Yoab kaa e ngɔ Uria kɛ da ta a nya ngɛ he nɛ a maa gbe lɛ. Benɛ Uria gbo ɔ, David ngɔ Batsheba kɛ pee e yo.

Yehowa mi mi fu David wawɛɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ gbalɔ Natan nɛ e ya de David ní yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ. Natan ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ David tsɔɔe ngɛ foni ɔ mi ɔ nɛ. David pia e he wawɛɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ he, lɔɔ heje ɔ, Yehowa gbi lɛ. Se Yehowa de lɛ ke: ‘Akɛnɛ o pee ní yayamihi nɛ ɔmɛ heje ɔ, haomihi fuu maa ba o we ɔ mi.’ Nɛ hyɛ haomi nɛ ba David nɔ!

Kekleekle ɔ, Batsheba bimwɔyo ɔ gbo. Nɛ David bitɛte Amnon hu nu e nyɛmiyo Tamar pani nya nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ si. Enɛ ɔ ha David binyumu Absalom mi mi fu Amnon wawɛɛ, nɛ e gbe lɛ. Pee se ɔ, nihi fuu ba nyɛɛ Absalom se nɛ e ha a wo lɛ matsɛ. Nyagbe ɔ, David ye Absalom nɔ kunimi, nɛ a gbe Absalom. Niinɛ, David kɛ haomihi fuu kpe.

Be nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ, Batsheba fɔ binyumu nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Salomo. Benɛ David bwɔ nɛ e be he wami ɔ, e binyumu Adoniya ka kaa e maa ye matsɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, David ha osɔfo Zadok pɔ Salomo nu kɛ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ nɛ e maa ye matsɛ ngɛ David se. Lɔɔ se ɔ, e kɛ we nɛ David gbo benɛ e ye jeha 70. David ye matsɛ jeha 40, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, Salomo ji Israel matsɛ.2 Samuel 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Matsɛmɛ 1:1-48. Sane Bimihi

SALOMO bɔni matsɛ yemi benɛ e ji niheyo wayoo. E suɔ Yehowa, nɛ e bu ga womi kpakpa nɛ e tsɛ David kɛ ha lɛ ɔ tue. Yehowa bua jɔ Salomo he, lɔɔ he ɔ, ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, e bi Salomo ngɛ nlami mi ke: ‘Salomo, mɛni o suɔ nɛ ma pee ha mo?’

Salomo ha heto ke: ‘Yehowa ye Mawu, niheyo wayoo ji mi, nɛ i li bɔnɛ a yeɔ ma nɔ ha. Lɔɔ he ɔ, ha mi níle nɛ ma kɛ ye o ma a nɔ ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.’

Yehowa bua jɔ nɔ́ nɛ Salomo bi ɔ he. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Yehowa de Salomo ke: ‘Akɛnɛ o bi níle se pi wami se kɛmi loo ní nami heje ɔ, ma ha mo níle pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ́ hi si hyɛ. Se ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ o bi we nɛ ji ní nami kɛ anunyami hulɔ.’

E yi be ko nɛ yihi enyɔ ngɔ sane ko nɛ mi wa kɛ ba fɔ Salomo hɛ mi. Yo nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ de ke: ‘I kɛ yo nɛ ɔ ngɛ we kake mi. I fɔ binyumu, nɛ ligbi enyɔ se ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ binyumu. Se ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, e bimwɔyo ɔ gbo. Nɛ benɛ i hwɔ mahe ɔ, e ngɔ e bi nɛ gbo ɔ kɛ ba tsake ye bi nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ i te si nɛ i hyɛ bimwɔyo nɛ gbo ɔ, i na kaa pi ye bi ɔ ji lɛ.’

Se yo kaketsɛ ɔ de ke: ‘Dɛbi! Bi nɛ́ hɛ ngɛ ɔ ji ye nɔ́, nɛ bi gbogboe ɔ ji e nɔ́!’ Yo nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ de ke: ‘O bua! Bi gbogboe ɔ ji o nɔ́, nɛ bi nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ ji ye nɔ́!’ Kikɛ ji bɔnɛ yi ɔmɛ je atsinyɛ. Kɛ Salomo maa pee kɛɛ?

Salomo tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ klaate kɛ ba, nɛ e de ke: ‘Dlaa bimwɔyo nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ́ o ngɔ fã kɛ ha yo nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, konɛ o ngɔ fã hu kɛ ha yo kaketsɛ ɔ.’ Se nɔ nɛ ji bi nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ nyɛ tutuutu ɔ kpa ngmlaa ke: ‘Dɛbi! I kpa mo pɛɛ, koo gbe bimwɔyo ɔ. Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ha yo kpa a!’ Se yo kaketsɛ ɔ de ke: ‘Koo ngɔ kɛ ha wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; moo dla e mi enyɔ.’

Nyagbe ɔ, Salomo de ke: ‘Koo gbe bimwɔyo ɔ! Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ha yo nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ. Lɛ ji bi ɔ nyɛ tutuutu.’ Salomo yɔse enɛ ɔ ejakaa binyɛ nitsɛ ɔ suɔ bimwɔyo ɔ wawɛɛ nɛ e suɔ kaa e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ha yo kaketsɛ ɔ bɔnɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe lɛ. Benɛ mabi ɔmɛ nu bɔnɛ Salomo tsu sane ɔ he ní ha a, a bua jɔ kaa a ngɛ matsɛ ní lelɔ kaa ja.

Benɛ Salomo ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, Mawu jɔɔ mabi ɔmɛ nɛ e ha zugba a ba ngma, wai tso yiblii, kɛ niye ní kpahi babauu. Mabi ɔmɛ woɔ tadehi nɛ́ ngɛ fɛu nɛ a hi wehi nɛ́ ngɛ fɛu hu a mi. Ní kpakpahi fuu ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.1 Matsɛmɛ 3:3-28; 4:29-34. Sane Bimihi

LOKO David ma gbo ɔ, e ngɔ Yehowa sɔlemi we ɔ he foni nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ kɛ ha Salomo. Salomo je sɔlemi we ɔ mami sisi ngɛ e nɔyemi jeha eywiɛne ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ jeha kpaago kɛ fã kɛ gbe nya. Nyumuhi akpe nyɔngmahi abɔ tsu ní kɛ ma sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ tsu ɔ mami hu ngɔ sika fuu. Ejakaa, a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ fuu kɛ ma sɔlemi we ɔ.

Sɔlemi we ɔ hɛɛ tsuhi pɔtɛɛ enyɔ, kaa kpe he bo tsu ɔ. Se tsu nɛ ɔmɛ kle pe tsuhi nɛ a ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ si enyɔ. Salomo ha nɛ a ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ma se tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɔ ní kpahi hu nɛ́ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ kɛ to tsu kpa a mi.

Benɛ a gbe sɔlemi we ɔ mami nya a, a ngmɛ okplɔɔ nguaa ko. Salomo kpla si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ hɛ mi nɛ e sɔle, kaa bɔnɛ o na ngɛ foni ɔ mi ɔ. Salomo de Yehowa ke: ‘Hiɔwe tete po kpi mo, lɛɛ kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ maa kpe mo. Se, ye Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke o ma a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ hiɛ ɔ nɛ a sɔle ɔ, bu mɛ tue.’

Benɛ Salomo sɔle ta a, la je hiɔwe kɛ ba sa lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa sa afɔle ɔ ngɛ afɔle sami latɛ ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ la ko nɛ ngɛ kpɛe je Yehowa ngɔ ba hyi sɔlemi we ɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yehowa ngɛ tue bue, nɛ e bua jɔ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ Salomo sɔlemi ɔ hu he. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, sɔlemi we ɔ ba da kpe he bo tsu ɔ nane mi, kaa he nɛ mabi ɔmɛ ma ja ngɛ. Salomo ngɔ ní lemi kɛ ye mabi ɔmɛ a nɔ be kɛkɛɛ, nɛ a ná bua jɔmi. Se Salomo ya ngɔ ma se yihi fuu nɛ́ a ja we Yehowa. Anɛ o na a ti nɔ kake nɛ ngɛ amaga jae ngɛ foni ɔ mi lo? Nyagbe ɔ, Salomo yi ɔmɛ ha nɛ lɛ hu e ba bɔni amaga jami. Anɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ba benɛ Salomo bɔni enɛ ɔ peemi ɔ lo? E nɛ́ mabi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ hu. E plɛ yiwutsotsɛ, nɛ mabi ɔmɛ a bua jɔɛ hu.

Enɛ ɔ ha Yehowa mi mi fu Salomo, nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ o dɛ nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha nɔ kpa. I be pee ngɛ o yinɔ, se ma pee benɛ o bi ngɛ nɔ yee. Se i be matsɛ yemi ɔ sisi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔe kɛ je o bi ɔ dɛ.’ Ha nɛ waa hyɛ bɔnɛ enɛ ɔ ba ha.1 Kronika 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Matsɛmɛ 5:1-18; 2 Kronika 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Matsɛmɛ 11:9-13. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: A Dla Matsɛ Yemi ɔ Mi
data.contenido:
ANƐ o le nɔ́ nɛ ha nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ e tade ɔ gbae lo? Yehowa ji nɔ nɛ de lɛ kaa e pee ja. Nyumu nɛ ɔ ji Mawu gbalɔ, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahiya. Anɛ o le nɔ nɛ ji gbalɔ lo? E ji nɔ ko nɛ Mawu deɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se kɛ sɛɛ hlami.

Nɔ nɛ Ahiya kɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ ji Yeroboam. Yeroboam ji nyumu ko nɛ Salomo ngɔ lɛ kɛ to tsu mami nítsumi ɔ eko nya. Benɛ Ahiya kɛ Yeroboam kpe ngɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ, Ahiya pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko. E je e tade he nɛ e wo ɔ nɛ e dla mi 12. Nɛ e de Yeroboam ke: ‘Moo ngɔ 10.’ Anɛ o le yi mi tomi heje nɛ Ahiya ha Yeroboam tade ɔ nɛ e dla mi ɔ mi 10 lo?

Ahiya tsɔɔ nya kaa Yehowa ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ je Salomo dɛ. E de hu kaa Yehowa maa ngɔ wɛtso 10 kɛ ha Yeroboam. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wɛtso enyɔ pɛ nɛ maa piɛ ha Salomo bi Rehoboam nɛ́ e ye nɔ.

Benɛ Salomo nu munyu nɛ Ahiya de Yeroboam ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ. E ka kaa e maa gbe Yeroboam. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Yeroboam tu fo kɛ ho Mizraim ya. Be bɔɔ se ɔ, Salomo gbo. E ye Israel nɔ jeha 40, se jehanɛ ɔ, a wo e bi Rehoboam matsɛ. Yeroboam nu ngɛ Mizraim kaa Salomo gbo, lɔɔ he ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba Israel.

Pi matsɛ kpakpa ji Rehoboam. E wa mabi ɔmɛ yi mi pe e tsɛ Salomo po. Yeroboam kɛ ma nimeli komɛ ya Matsɛ Rehoboam ngɔ nɛ a ya de lɛ kaa e na mabi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ. Se Rehoboam pui a nya mi fɛɛ. Ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ, e yi mi ba wa po pe kekle ɔ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, mabi ɔmɛ ngɔ Yeroboam kɛ to wɛtso 10 nya matsɛ. Se wɛtso enyɔ nɛ ji Benyamin kɛ Yuda lɛɛ a ha Rehoboam ya nɔ nɛ e ye a nɔ matsɛ.

Yeroboam sume kaa e mabi ɔmɛ nɛ ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ja Yehowa ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e pee sika tsu na bi enyɔ nɛ e ha wɛtso 10 matsɛ yemi ɔ sisi bi ɔmɛ ja mɛ. E kɛ we nɛ zugba a nɔ ba hyi tɔ kɛ awi yemi kɛ basabasa peemi.

Haomi ngɛ wɛtso enyɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi hulɔ. Benɛ Rehoboam ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, e sui jeha enuɔ nɛ Mizraim matsɛ kɛ Yerusalem ba hwu ta. E ngɔ Yehowa sɔlemi we ɔ mi níhi fuu kɛ je. Lɔɔ he ɔ, bɔnɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ ha benɛ a ma a, hi si be kpiti pɛ.1 Matsɛmɛ 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Sane Bimihi

BENƐ matsɛ Yeroboam gbo se ɔ, matsɛ tsuaa matsɛ nɛ ye yiti je Israel wɛtso 10 nɔ ɔ, ji matsɛ yayami. Matsɛ Ahab ji matsɛ yayami nɛ pe mɛ tsuo. O le nɔ́ heje lo? Nɔ́ titli heje ji kaa, e yo nɛ ji Manyɛ Yezebel yi kpɛti wa.

Pi Israelno ji Yezebel. E ji Sidon matsɛ biyo. E jaa wɔ nɛ ji Baal, nɛ e ha Ahab kɛ Israelbi fuu hu ja Baal. Yezebel sume Yehowa nɛ e gbe E gbali fuu. Gbali ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ya laa ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi konɛ Yezebel nɛ ko gbe mɛ. Be komɛ ke Yezebel ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ ɔ, e gbeɔ nɔ konɛ e nine nɛ su nɔ.

Ligbi ko ɔ, Matsɛ Ahab bua jɔɛ kulaa. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Yezebel bi lɛ ke: ‘Mɛni heje nɛ o be bua jɔmi mwɔnɛ ɔ?’

Ahab ha heto ke: ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Nabot de mi ɔ heje. I suɔ kaa ma he e wai ngmɔ ɔ. Se e de mi ke e be juae ha mi.’

Yezebel de lɛ ke: ‘Koo ye tsui. Ma ngɔ ngɛ e dɛ ha mo.’

Lɔɔ he ɔ, Yezebel ngma womi kɛ ya ha nimeli komɛ nɛ ngɛ Nabot ma a mi. E de mɛ ke: ‘Nyɛ hla yaka nimli komɛ nɛ a po Nabot nya kaa e gbiɛ Mawu kɛ matsɛ ɔ. Lɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ Nabot kɛ je ma a mi nɛ́ nyɛɛ fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.’

Benɛ Yezebel nu Nabot gbenɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e de Ahab ke: ‘Jehanɛ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya ngɔ e wai ngmɔ ɔ.’ Anɛ o kplɛɛ we nɔ kaa e sa nɛ a gbla Yezebel tue ngɛ yiwutso ní peepee nɛ ɔ he lo?

Pee se ɔ, Yehowa tsɔ Yehu nɛ́ e ya gbla Yezebel tue. Benɛ Yezebel nu kaa Yehu ma a, e ngɔ tsopa kɛ kpa e hɛngmɛ se, nɛ e dla e he konɛ e he nɛ pee fɛu. Se benɛ Yehu ba na Yezebel nɛ e hii si ngɛ saflɛ ɔ nya a, e de nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ke: ‘Nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ fia si!’ Nyumu ɔmɛ pee ja, kaa bɔnɛ o na ngɛ foni ɔ mi ɔ. A tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ fia zugba nɛ e gbo. Manyɛ Yezebel yiwutsotsɛ ɔ nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.1 Matsɛmɛ 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Matsɛmɛ 9:30-37. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: Yehoshafat Ngɔ E He Kɛ Fɔ Yehowa Nɔ
data.contenido:
ANƐ o le nimli nɛ nyumuhi nɛ ɔmɛ ji, nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ lo? A yaa hwu ta, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ɔ ngɛ lae. Se eko ɔ, o ma bi ke: ‘Mɛni heje lali ɔmɛ hɛɛ we klaate kɛ akplɔ nɛ a ma kɛ hwu ta a?’ Ha nɛ waa hyɛ.

Yehoshafat ji Israel wɛtso enyɔ ɔ matsɛ. E kɛ Matsɛ Ahab nɛ ji yiti je wɛtso 10 matsɛ kɛ e yo Yezebel hi si ngɛ be kake mi. Yehoshafat ji matsɛ kpakpa kaa e tsɛ Asa. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, woyi je wɛtso enyɔ matsɛ yemi sisi bi ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi jehahi babauu.

Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko ba nɛ́ ha mabi ɔmɛ ye gbeye. Tsɔli ba bɔ Yehoshafat amaniɛ ke: ‘Tabuli babauu je Moab, Amon kɛ Seir Yoku ɔ nɔ kɛ ma mo tuami.’ Isrealbi ɔmɛ fuu ya bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem konɛ a bi Yehowa dɛ mi yemi kɛ buami. A ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ Yehoshafat sɔle ke: ‘Oo Yehowa wa Mawu, wa li bɔnɛ wa maa pee ha. Wa be nyɛe maa da ta nɛ ɔ nya. Wa ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe nɛ o ye bua wɔ.’

Yehowa bu Yehoshafat sɔlemi ɔ tue, nɛ e ha e gbalɔ de mabi ɔmɛ ke: ‘Ta a pi nyɛ nɔ́, se Mawu nɔ́. E hia we nɛ nyɛɛ hwu ta. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ mlɛ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔnɛ Yehowa ma he nyɛ yi wami ha.’

E nɔ jena a, Yehoshafat de mabi ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ fɔ Yehowa nɔ!’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e ha lali la Yehowa yi jemi lahi kɛ nyɛɛ tabuli ɔmɛ a hlami. Anɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ba benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su ta nga a nɔ lo? Yehowa ha nɛ henyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he nɔ kunɔ. Nɛ benɛ Isrealbi ɔmɛ ya su lejɛ ɔ, a na kaa tabuli ɔmɛ tsuo gbo kɛ pue si!

Anɛ e pi níle blɔ kaa Yehoshafat ngɔ e he kɛ fɔ Yehowa nɔ lo? Wɔ hu wa maa pee ní leli ke wa ngɔ wa he kɛ fɔ Yehowa nɔ.1 Matsɛmɛ 22:41-53; 2 Kronika 20:1-30. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: Nyumuwi Enyɔ Nɛ Ba Wami Mi Ekohu
data.contenido:
KE O gbo nɛ a kpale ngɔ mo kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, kɛ o yayo maa pee kɛɛ? E bua maa jɔ wawɛɛ! Se anɛ nɔ ko nɛ e gbo ma nyɛ maa ba wami mi ekohu lo? Eko ba ja hyɛ lo?

Hyɛ nyumu ɔ, kɛ yo ɔ, kɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ngɛ foni ɔ mi. Nyumu ɔ ji gbalɔ Eliya. Nɛ yo ɔ ji yalɔyo ko nɛ ngɛ Zarefat ma a mi, nɛ e bi ji jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ. Ligbi ko ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ nu hiɔ wawɛɛ. E hiɔ ɔ mi ba wa nɛ nyagbe ɔ, e gbo. Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya de yo ɔ ke: ‘Ngɔɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ha mi.’

Eliya ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi ya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya fɔ sa nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e sɔle ke: ‘Oo Yehowa, ha jokuɛ ɔ nɛ ba wami mi ekohu.’ Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ bɔni mumu womi! Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ kple si ya ha e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Hyɛ, o bi ɔ ba wami mi ekohu!’ Enɛ ɔ heje nɛ jokuɛ ɔ nyɛ ɔ bua jɔ wawɛɛ ɔ nɛ.

A tsɛɛ Yehowa gbalɔ ngua kpa ko hu ke Elisha. E sɔmɔ Eliya. Se pee se ɔ, Yehowa gu e nɔ kɛ pee nyakpɛ níhi fuu. Ligbi ko ɔ, Elisha ya Shunem ma a mi, nɛ yo ko pee lɛ kpakpa. Pee se ɔ, yo ɔ ba fɔ binyumuyo.

Benɛ jokuɛ ɔ wa saii ɔ, e kɛ e tsɛ ho ngmɔ mi ya ligbi ko mɔtu. Si kake too ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ hia ngmlaa ke: ‘Ye yi ngɛ mi yee!’ Benɛ a ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ya su we ɔ mi ɔ, e gbo. E nyɛ ye aywilɛho! Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e ho ya tsɛ Elisha.

Benɛ Elisha ba a, e ho he nɛ a ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ fɔ ɔ ya. E sɔle ha Yehowa, nɛ e ya bu jokuɛ ɔ nɔ. Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ he dɔ la, kɛkɛ nɛ e tsile si kpaago. E nyɛ ɔ bua jɔ nitsɛ kaa e bi ɔ ba wami mi ekohu!

Nihi babauu gbo. Nɛ enɛ ɔ wo a wekuli kɛ a huɛmɛ aywilɛho. Wa be he wami nɛ waa kɛ maa tsiɛ gbogboehi. Se Yehowa lɛɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e ma kɛ pee ja. Pee se ɔ, wa maa kase bɔnɛ Yehowa maa pee ha kɛ ngɔ nihi ayɔhi abɔ nɛ gbo ɔ kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.1 Matsɛmɛ 17:8-24; 2 Matsɛmɛ 4:8-37. Sane Bimihi

data.titulo: Jokuɛ Yoyo Ko Ye Bua Nɔmlɔ Ngua Ko
data.contenido:
ANƐ o le nɔ́ nɛ jokuɛ yoyo nɛ ɔ ngɛ dee lo? E ngɛ nyakpɛ ní nɛ Yehowa gu gbalɔ Elisha nɔ nɛ́ e pee ɔmɛ a he ní sɛɛe ha alua a. Alua a li Yehowa ejakaa pi Israelno ji lɛ. Se ha nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ha jokuɛ yoyo ɔ ba je alua a we mi.

Siriayo ji alua a nɛ. A tsɛɛ e huno ke Naeman, nɛ e ji Siria tabuli ɔmɛ a tatsɛ. Siriabi ɔmɛ nu Israel yoyo nɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ba ha Naeman yo ɔ konɛ e sɔmɔ lɛ.

Hiɔ yaya nɛ a tsɛɛ ke kpiti ɔ ngɛ Naeman he. Hiɔ nɛ ɔ nyɛɔ nɛ e haa nɔ helo po yeɔ. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jokuɛ yoyo ɔ ngɛ Naeman yo ɔ dee ji: ‘I ná nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ya Yehowa gbalɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ Israel. Jinɛ e ma tsa e kpiti ɔ ha lɛ.’ Pee se ɔ, a ya bɔ e huno ɔ amaniɛ.

Naeman suɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ; lɔɔ heje ɔ, e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa ya Israel. Benɛ e su Israel ɔ, e pue Elisha we ɔ mi blɔ. Elisha tsɔ e sɔmɔlɔ ɔ kaa e ya de Naeman nɛ́ e ya du e he ngɛ Yordan Pa a mi si kpaago. Munyu nɛ ɔ wo Naeman mi mi la, nɛ e de ke: ‘Pa amɛ ngɛ ye ma a mi ɔ hi kulaa pe Israel pa amɛ!’ Benɛ Naeman de enɛ ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale.

Se e tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake de lɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa pe Elisha de mo ke o pee nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa a, o ko pee we lo? Nɛ mɛni heje nɛ o ya dui o he kɛkɛ mɔ, kaa bɔnɛ e de ɔ?’ Naeman bu e tsɔlɔ ɔ tue nɛ e ya du ngɛ Yordan Pa a mi si kpaago. Kɛkɛ nɛ e he womi ɔ pee ehe ekohu!

Naeman bua jɔ saminya. E kpale kɛ ho Elisha ngɔ ya nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Kpaako i na kaa Israel Mawu ɔ pɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo. Lɔɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ nike ní nɛ ɔ.’ Se Elisha he nɔ ke: ‘Dɛbi, i be ngɔe.’ Elisha le kaa e ji tɔmi kaa e maa ngɔ nike ní ɔ, ejakaa Yehowa lɛ tsa Naeman. Se Elisha tsɔlɔ Gehazi lɛɛ e suɔ nike ní ɔ.

Lɔɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Gehazi pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Benɛ Naeman je kɛ yaa, Gehazi tu fo kɛ ya ná lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ. Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Elisha tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mo nɛ o ha lɛ nike ní ɔ eko nɛ́ e kɛ ha e huɛmɛ nɛ ba lɛ slaami ɔ.’ Enɛ ɔ ji lakpa. Se Naeman lɛɛ e li ja; lɔɔ heje ɔ, e ha lɛ ní ɔmɛ eko.

Benɛ Gehazi kpale kɛ ba we mi ɔ, Elisha le nɔ́ nɛ e ya pee ɔ. Yehowa de lɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e de lɛ ke: ‘Akɛnɛ o pee nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ heje ɔ, Naeman kpiti ɔ ma pue mo.’ Nɛ amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e ba mi ja!

Mɛni wa ma nyɛ maa kase kɛ je sane nɛ ɔ mi? Kekleekle nɔ́ ji kaa, e sa nɛ waa sɛɛ Yehowa he ní ha ni kpahi kaa bɔnɛ jokuɛ yoyo ɔ pee ɔ. Se nami ngɛ he babauu. Enyɔne ji kaa, wa ko wo wa he nɔ kaa bɔnɛ Naeman pee kekle ɔ, mohu ɔ, waa bu Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ tue. Nɛ etɛne ɔ, wa ko ye lakpa kaa bɔnɛ Gehazi pee ɔ. Anɛ wa be ní babauu lee ke wa kase Baiblo ɔ lo?2 Matsɛmɛ 5:1-27. Sane Bimihi

HYƐ nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyu ɔ mi ɔ. E sɛ haomi mi, aloo pi ja? Lo ɔ yaa mi lɛ! Anɛ o le nɔ nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ji lo? E biɛ ji Yona. Ha nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ha e ya sɛ haomi nɛ ɔ mi.

Yona ji Yehowa gbalɔ. Benɛ gbalɔ Elisha gbo ɔ, e kɛ we tsɔ nɛ Yehowa de Yona ke: ‘Yaa Nineve ma a mi. Mabi ɔmɛ ngɛ yayami pee wawɛɛ, nɛ i suɔ kaa o ya bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ.’

Se Yona sume kaa e maa ya. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e ya sɛ lɛ nɛ yaa he kpa kulaa mi. Yehowa bua jɔɛ he kaa Yona ngɛ fo tue. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko fia. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya wami ɔ ha nɛ lɛ ɔ bɔni mumi. Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ a tsui po wawɛɛ, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ a mawu ɔmɛ konɛ a ye bua mɛ. Nyagbe ɔ, Yona de mɛ ke: ‘I jaa Yehowa, Mawu nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a. Nɛ i ngɛ fo tue ngɛ nítsumi ko nɛ Yehowa ha mi ɔ nya.’ Lɔɔ heje ɔ, lɛ hluili ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: ‘Mɛni waa pee mo konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya nɛ ba si?’

Yona de mɛ ke: ‘Nyɛ sake mi kɛ fɔ wo ɔ mi, kɛkɛ wo ɔ he maa jɔ.’ Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ sume kaa a maa pee ja, se nyagbe ɔ, benɛ a na kaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae ɔ nya ngɛ wae po pe kekle ɔ, a sake Yona kɛ fɔ wo ɔ mi. Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya ba si, nɛ wo ɔ he jɔ.

Yona mu kɛ ho nyu ɔ sisi ya, nɛ lo ngua a mi lɛ. Se e gbo we. Yona hi lo ɔ mi mi nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ. Yona pia e he kaa e bui Yehowa tue konɛ e ya Nineve. Lɔɔ he ɔ, o le nɔ́ nɛ e pee lo?

Yona sɔle kɛ ha Yehowa nɛ́ e ye bua lɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehowa ha lo ɔ ya vie lɛ kɛ pue wo ɔ nya. Lɔɔ se ɔ, Yona ya Nineve. Anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we wɔ bɔnɛ e he hia ha kaa waa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yehowa deɔ wɔ ɔ lo?Baiblo mi womi nɛ ji Yona 1-4. Sane Bimihi

FONI nɛ ɔ ji paradeiso he foni nɛ́ eko ɔ, Yehowa je kɛ tsɔɔ e gbalɔ Yesaya. Yesaya hi si ngɛ gbalɔ Yona gbenɔ se.

Paradeiso sisi ji “abɔɔ.” Anɛ e kai mo nɔ́ ko nɛ wa kase he ní kɛ sɛ hlami momo ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi lo? E ngɛ kaa abɔɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ nɛ Yehowa pee ngɔ ha Adam kɛ Hawa a, aloo pi ja? Se anɛ zugba a tsuo ma nyɛ ma plɛ paradeiso niinɛ lo?

Yehowa de e gbalɔ Yesaya kaa e ngma paradeiso ehe nɛ maa ba ha E webi ɔ he sane. E de ke: ‘Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ maa hi si ngɛ he kake ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Nɛ na bi kɛ jata bi ma bla kɛ ye ní, nɛ jokuɛ bɔbɔyoo maa hyɛ a nɔ. Ke bimwɔyo ya fiɛ ngɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛ kasa nya po e be lɛ nɔ́ ko pee.’

Eko ɔ, nihi fuu ma de ke: ‘Enɛ ɔ be nyɛe maa ba mi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Haomi ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e maa ya nɔ ja daa.’ Se mo susu he nɛ o hyɛ: Kɛ si himi he nɛ Yehowa ha Adam kɛ Hawa ngɛ kɛɛ?

Mawu ngɔ Adam kɛ Hawa kɛ wo paradeiso mi. Yehowa tue nɛ a gbo ɔ heje nɛ a je mɛ kɛ je a si himi he nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ nɛ, nɛ a bwɔ nɛ a gbo. Se Mawu wo si kaa e maa ngɔ níhi nɛ je Adam kɛ Hawa dɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ.

Haomi aloo nɔ́ nami ko be paradeiso nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ mi hie. Tue mi jɔmi maa hi si. Adesahi tsuo ma ná nɔmlɔtso mi he wami kɛ bua jɔmi. E maa hi kaa bɔnɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e hi ngɛ sisije ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Se pee se ɔ, wa maa kase bɔnɛ Mawu maa pee enɛ ɔ ha a he ní.Yesaya 11:6-9; Kpojemi 21:3, 4. Sane Bimihi

ANƐ o le nɔ́ heje nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ sɔlee ha Yehowa lo? Mɛni heje nɛ e ngɔ womi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba pue Yehowa afɔle sami latɛ ɔ hɛ mi? Nyumu nɛ ɔ ji Hezekia. E ji Israel woyi je wɛtso enyɔ ɔmɛ a matsɛ. Nɛ e sɛ haomi mi. Mɛni heje?

Nɔ́ heje ji kaa, Asiria tabuli ɔmɛ kpata yiti je wɛtso 10 matsɛ yemi ɔ hɛ mi momo. Yehowa ha nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ejakaa a ji yayami peeli. Nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Asiria tabuli ɔmɛ ba konɛ a kɛ woyi je wɛtso enyɔ ɔ hu nɛ́ ba hwu ta.

Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngma womi kɛ tsɔ nɔ ya ha Hezekia. Womi ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia kɛ ba pue Mawu afɔle sami latɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. Matsɛ ɔ ye Yehowa he fɛu ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e de Hezekia kaa e ngmɛɛ e he kɛ ha lɛ. Enɛ ɔ heje ɔ, Hezekia sɔle kɛ ha Yehowa ke: ‘Oo Yehowa, kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, jema amɛ tsuo maa na kaa mo pɛ ji Mawu.’ Anɛ Yehowa maa bu Hezekia tue lo?

Hezekia ji matsɛ kpakpa. E be kaa Israel wɛtso 10 matsɛmɛ yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ e be kaa e tsɛ Ahaz hulɔ. Hezekia bɔ mɔde nɛ e ye Yehowa mlaa amɛ tsuo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔɔ heje ɔ, benɛ e sɔle ta a, gbalɔ Yesaya tsɔ nɛ a ya de lɛ sɛgbi nɛ je Yehowa ngɔ ke: ‘Asiria matsɛ ɔ be Yerusalem bae. E tabuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hu be ma a mi bae. A be kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po tsɛ̃e kɛ ba ma a mi.’ Hyɛ foni ɔ ngɛ bafa nɛ ɔ mi. Anɛ o le nihi nɛ́ tabuli nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si ɔ ji lo? Asiriabi ji mɛ. Yehowa tsɔ e bɔfo nɛ e ya gbe Asiria tabuli 185,000 ngɛ nyɔ kake pɛ mi. Enɛ ɔ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.

A baa wɛtso enyɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ yi, nɛ mabi ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi be saii. Hezekia ba gbo, nɛ e bi Manase ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se. Se Manase kɛ e bi Amon nɛ ba ye e se ɔ tsuo ji matsɛmɛ yayamihi. Lɔɔ heje awi yemi kɛ basabasa peemi ba pɔ he ngɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu kaa kekle ɔ. Matsɛ Amon nitsɛ e tsɔli gbe lɛ, nɛ a to e bi Yosia wɛtso enyɔ ɔ nya matsɛ.2 Matsɛmɛ 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Sane Bimihi

YOSIA ye jeha kpaanyɔ pɛ nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel woyi je wɛtso enyɔ ɔ nya. E wɛ kulaa kɛ ha matsɛ yemi. Lɔɔ he ɔ, sisije ɔ nikɔtɔmahi komɛ ye bua lɛ kɛ ye ma a nɔ.

Benɛ Yosia ye matsɛ jeha kpaago ɔ, e bɔni Yehowa se blɔ hlami. E nyɛɛ matsɛmɛ kpakpahi kaa David, Yehoshafat, kɛ Hezekia nɔhyɛ nɔ́ ɔ se. Nɛ benɛ e yi jeha nyingmi enyɔ lolo po ɔ, e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ́ biɔ kã peemi.

Israelbi ɔmɛ babauu pee ní yayamihi be kɛkɛɛ. A ja wɔhi. Nɛ a kpla si ha amagahi. Lɔɔ he ɔ, Yosia kɛ e webi ɔmɛ sɛ ma a mi nɛ a ya puɛ lakpa jami he ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Nítsumi nɛ ɔ he wa nitsɛ ejakaa wɔ jali ɔmɛ hiɛ. Hyɛ Yosia kɛ e webi ɔmɛ ngɛ foni ɔ mi nɛ a ngɛ amaga amɛ kue pue si.

Pee se ɔ, Yosia hla nyumuhi etɛ konɛ a hyɛ nɛ a dla Yehowa sɔlemi we ɔ. Mabi ɔmɛ tsu sika kɛ ha mɛ konɛ a kɛ wo nítsumi ɔ he hiɔ. Ligbi ko nɛ́ a ngɛ ní ɔ tsue ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Hilkia na nɔ́ ko nɛ he hia wawɛɛ. Lɔɔ ji mlaa womi nɛ́ Yehowa ha Mose ngma fɔ si blema lokoo ɔ. E laa jeha babauu.

A ngɔ womi ɔ ya ha Yosia, nɛ e ha a kane ha lɛ. Benɛ Yosia ngɛ womi ɔ kanemi ɔ tue bue ɔ, e na kaa mabi ɔmɛ yi Yehowa mlaa nɔ kulaa. E dɔ lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha e gba e tade ngɛ e he, kaa bɔnɛ o na ngɛ foni ɔ mi ɔ. E de ke: ‘Yehowa mi mi fu wɔ, ejakaa wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ yi mlaa nɛ́ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ nɔ.’ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yosia fã osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Hilkia kaa e ya bi nɔ́ nɛ Yehowa maa pee mɛ. Hilkia ya gbalɔyo Hulda ngɔ, nɛ e ya bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba. Sɛgbi nɛ je Yehowa ngɔ nɛ gbalɔyo ɔ kɛ ha Hilkia kaa e ya de Yosia ji: ‘A maa gbla Yerusalem kɛ mabi ɔmɛ tsuo tue, ejakaa a ja wɔhi nɛ a ha ma a mi hyi tɔ kɛ yayami peemi. Se mo Yosia, akɛnɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da heje ɔ, tue gblami nɛ ɔ maa ba ngɛ o gbenɔ se.’2 Kronika 34:1-28. Sane Bimihi

MOO hyɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ niheyo ɔ he fɛu yee. O le niheyo ɔ lo? E biɛ ji Yeremia. Nɛ e ji Mawu gbalɔ ngua.

Benɛ Yosia bɔni amaga amɛ puɛmi ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, e kɛ we tsɔ nɛ Yehowa de Yeremia kaa e pee E gbalɔ. Se, Yeremia susu kaa e wɛ bɔnɛ e ma nyɛ maa pee gbalɔ. Se Yehowa de lɛ kaa e maa ye bua lɛ.

Yeremia de Israelbi ɔmɛ kaa a jɔɔ ní yayamihi peemi. E de mɛ ke: ‘Jema amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ ji lakpa mawuhi.’ Se Israelbi ɔmɛ fuu suɔ kaa á ja amaga amɛ mohu pe Yehowa, anɔkuale Mawu ɔ. Nɛ benɛ Yeremia de mɛ kaa Mawu maa gbla a tue ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, muɔmi kɛkɛ nɛ a muɔ lɛ.

Jehahi ba be. Yosia gbo, nɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ se ɔ, a to e bi Yehoyakim matsɛ. Yeremia de ni ɔmɛ si abɔ ke: ‘A ma kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ ní peepee yayami ɔmɛ.’ Osɔfo ɔmɛ nu Yeremia nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wo e yi ke: ‘O sa gbenɔ ngɛ munyuhi nɛ o ngɛ tue nɛ ɔmɛ a heje.’ Lɔɔ se ɔ, a de Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɛɛ gbe Yeremia, ejakaa e tu munyu yayami kɛ si wa ma a.’

Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ Yeremia maa pee kɛɛ? E yi gbeye! E de mɛ tsuo ke: ‘Yehowa ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi kaa ma ba de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ ní peepee yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, Yehowa ma kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi. Se nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, ke nyɛ gbe mi ɔ, nyɛ gbe nɔmlɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko.’

Nimeli ɔmɛ gbi Yeremia, se Israelbi ɔmɛ hu tsakee we ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a peemi he. Pee se ɔ, Babilon matsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ Yerusalem ba hwu ta. Nyagbe mi ɔ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ Israelbi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛhi. E ngɔ nihi akpehi abɔ kɛ ho Babilon ya. Mo susu bɔnɛ e ma ji ha kaa nibwɔhi ma ba nu mo kɛ je mo nitsɛ o ma mi kɛ ho ma se ya!Yeremia 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Matsɛmɛ 24:1-17. Sane Bimihi

MATSƐ Nebukadnezar ngɔ Israelbi nɛ́ le womi mi saminya a tsuo kɛ ho Babilon ya. Pee se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hla a kpɛti nihi nɛ a hɛ mi tsɔ, nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa a. A kpɛti nihi eywiɛ lɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ foni ɔ mi ɔ nɛ. Nɔ kake biɛ ji Daniel, nɛ nihi etɛ nɛ piɛɛ e he ɔ hu Babilonbi ɔmɛ wo mɛ Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego.

Nebukadnezar yi mi tomi ji kaa e ma tsɔse nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ konɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi. Ke a tsɔse mɛ jeha etɛ se ɔ, e maa hla a kpɛti nihi nɛ a hɛ mi tsɔ saminya, konɛ a ye bua lɛ kɛ tsu sanehi a he ní. Matsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ ná nɔmlɔtso mi he wami ngɛ a tsɔsemi be ɔ tsuo mi. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e fã e tsɔli ɔmɛ kaa a ha mɛ niye ní kpakpa nɛ e kɛ e weku ɔ yeɔ, kɛ wai nɛ a nuɔ hu eko.

Moo hyɛ niheyo Daniel ha. O le nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ Nebukadnezar sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a nya tsɛ Ashpenaz dee lo? Daniel ngɛ lɛ dee ke a be matsɛ ɔ we okplɔɔ nɔ niye ní kpakpa a yee. Munyu ɔ hao Ashpenaz. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e de Daniel ke: ‘Matsɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ ye. Ke nyɛ yi nɛ́ nyɛ ná nɔmlɔtso mi he wami kaa nihewi kpa amɛ ɔ, e maa gbe mi.’

Lɔɔ he ɔ, Daniel ya nyumu nɛ Ashpenaz ngɔ kɛ to e kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a nya kaa e hyɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ. Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ka wɔ ligbi 10 nɛ o hyɛ. Ha wɔ ngmɔ mi ní tsɔwi kɛkɛ nɛ waa ye kɛ nyu nɛ́ waa nu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ wɔ kɛ to nihewi kpa amɛ nɛ yeɔ matsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ he, konɛ o hyɛ kaa wa ti mɛnɔ ma ná nɔmlɔtso mi he wami pe e nyɛmi.’

A nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ. Nɛ benɛ ligbi 10 su ɔ, e na kaa Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔtso mi he wami kulaa pe nihewi kpa amɛ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ha nɛ a ya nɔ nɛ a ye ngmɔ mi ní tsɔwi ɔmɛ mohu ngɛ matsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ nane mi.

Ngɛ jeha etɛ ɔ nyagbe ɔ, a ngɔ nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ya Nebukadnezar ngɔ. Nɛ benɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo sɛɛ ní se ɔ, e na kaa Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a hɛ mi tsɔ pe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e ha nɛ a hi e we ɔ mi nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ. Nɛ be tsuaa be nɛ Nebukadnezar ma bi Daniel, Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego munyu ko aloo e maa ngɔ sane ko nɛ mi wa kɛ fɔ a hɛ mi ɔ, a leɔ heto ɔ si 10 pe matsɛ ɔ wɔnɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ní leli ɔmɛ.Daniel 1:1-21. Sane Bimihi

JEHA 10 kɛ se ji nɛ ɔ nɛ́ Nebukadnezar ba ngɔ Israelbi nɛ a le womi mi saminya a tsuo kɛ ho Babilon ya. Nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae! A ngɛ Yerusalem ma a sãe. A gbe Israelbi ɔmɛ fã nɛ a nuu nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ yaa Babilon.

Mo kai kaa enɛ ɔ he kɔkɔ bɔmi ji nɔ́ nɛ Yehowa gbali ɔmɛ kɛ ha, kaa e maa ba ni ɔmɛ a nɔ ke a kpa we a ní peepee yayami ɔmɛ ɔ. Se Israelbi ɔmɛ bui gbali ɔmɛ tue. A ya nɔ nɛ a ja lakpa mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ Yehowa nane mi. Lɔɔ he ɔ, mabi ɔmɛ sa tue gblami. Wa le enɛ ɔ ejakaa Mawu gbalɔ Ezekiel de wɔ ní yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ pee ɔ.

Anɛ o le nɔ nɛ Ezekiel ji lo? E piɛɛ nihewi nɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya jeha 10 se loko Yerusalem hɛ mi kpatami ngua nɛ ɔ ba a he. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a ngɔ Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego hu kɛ ho Babilon ya a nɛ.

Yehowa je ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ Yerusalem sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Ezekiel ngɛ Babilon. Yehowa gu nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ pee enɛ ɔ. Ezekiel ngɛ Babilon, se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yehowa ha e na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ Yerusalem sɔlemi we ɔ. Níhi nɛ e na amɛ ngɛ gbeye!

Yehowa de Ezekiel ke: ‘Hyɛ mu níhi nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Hyɛ bɔnɛ a tɛni sinɔhi kɛ lohwe kpahi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ha. Nɛ hyɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ jae!’ Ezekiel na ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ tsuo nɛ e ngma.

Yehowa bi Ezekiel ke: ‘O na nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ laami mi lo?’ Ee, Ezekiel na enɛ ɔ hulɔ. E na nyumuhi 70 nɛ a ngɛ lakpa mawuhi jae. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji: ‘Yehowa nɛ́ wɔ. E si zugba a.’

Lɔɔ se ɔ, Yehowa tsɔɔ Ezekiel yihi komɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ yiti je agbo ɔ nya. A hii si nɛ a ngɛ lakpa mawu nɛ ji Tamuz jae. Nɛ hyɛ nyumuhi nɛ a ngɛ Yehowa sɔlemi we agbo ɔ nya a! A he hiɛmi maa su 25. Ezekiel na mɛ. Mɛ tsuo a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ puje he nɛ a ngɛ pu ɔ jae!

Yehowa de ke: ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ be bumi ko kulaa ha mi. Pi kaa a ngɛ ní yayamihi pee kɛkɛ, se a ngɔ kɛ ba su ye sɔlemi we ɔ tɔɔ!’ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yehowa wo si ke: ‘A kɛ ye abofu ɔ maa kpe. Nɛ ke a ngɛ a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ, i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae.’ Benɛ Yehowa je ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Ezekiel ɔ, e nɔ jeha etɛ mi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ tsɔ atua kɛ si Matsɛ Nebukadnezar. Lɔɔ he ɔ, e je ta kɛ ya ná mɛ. Jeha kake kɛ fa se ɔ, Babilonbi ɔmɛ nyɛ nɛ a ywia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ kɛ sɛ ma a mi nɛ a sã ma a butuu. A gbe mabi ɔmɛ fuu nɛ a ngɔ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya.

Mɛni heje Yehowa ha hɛ mi kpatami nɛ nya wa kikɛ ba Israelbi ɔmɛ a nɔ? Ejakaa a bui Yehowa tue nɛ a yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ hulɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔnɛ e he hia ha kaa waa pee nɔ́ nɛ Mawu deɔ wɔ be fɛɛ be.

Sisije ɔ, Babilonbi ɔmɛ ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Israelbi bɔɔ ko piɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ. Nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ Yudano ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gedalia kɛ to a nya. Se Israelbi komɛ gbe Gedalia. Lɔɔ ha ni ɔmɛ ye gbeye kaa Babilonbi ɔmɛ ma ba kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ heje. Lɔɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ Yeremia pani nya kɛ piɛɛ a he nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Mizraim ya.

Enɛ ɔ ha Israel zugba a fɔ si nɛ nɔ ko hí nɔ. Jeha 70 sɔuu ba be nɛ nɔ ko hí zugba a nɔ. Israel ma a pee ma doku. Se Yehowa wo si kaa jeha 70 se ɔ, e maa ngɔ e webi kɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba a nɔ ekohu. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ a ngɛ Yehowa webi ɔmɛ pee ngɛ Babilon kɛɛ? Ha nɛ waa hyɛ.2 Matsɛmɛ 25:1-26; Yeremia 29:10; Ezekiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Sane Bimihi
